name: Masked Champion of Justice
description: A gentle student with a hidden, enormous power. Patrols the towns in a ridiculous costume, rescues anyone in trouble, and unleashes everything when its friends are hurt.

journey.say_start: A quiet place to study... and to keep my costume.
The city needs a protector! Time to patrol!
I could help others train, like my mentor helped me.

milestones.name: Champion of Justice
milestones.say: Fear not, citizens! The champion of justice is here!
milestones.broadcast: A masked hero, %npc%, has been seen saving people all over!

milestones.name: Hidden Potential
milestones.say: STOP IT! I won't let you hurt anyone else!
milestones.broadcast: A massive power just erupted from %npc%!

milestones.name: Potential Unlocked
milestones.say: I feel... calm. And stronger than ever.

battle_cry: I don't want to fight... but I will!
victory: Please, go home and think about what you've done.
defeated: I... I should have studied harder...

requests.line: Raiders have been harassing travellers, %player%. Help me take down %count% %mob% - for justice!
Between fights I still have to study... could you find me %count% %item%? Mom would be thrilled.
